definitions.definition: A propositional variable a or its negation ¬a.
A disjunction of literals φ₁ ∨ … ∨ φₙ. The empty clause □ (n=0) is unsatisfiable.
A formula that is a conjunction of clauses (conjunction of disjunctions of literals).
A formula that is a disjunction of conjunctions of literals.
If φ ≡ φ', replacing one occurrence of φ in a formula φ₁ by φ' yields an equivalent formula φ₂.

algorithms: CNF conversion: push negations inward (De Morgan), distribute ∨ over ∧
